formula: Legal safe reachable target; preaction enemy cash >= seizure price. Add only to its actor logit: 1.5 * P(planter stays | our current/last obs) * min(remaining game steps, live tree life)/lifespan * bank discount. Discount=1/(1+cargo/30) if one step from home and loaded, otherwise 1. Max +1.5 logits. Precommitted before trial.
scope: Frozen 1200k int8 actor. Hook runs prior to prefix advance; full joint decode falls back on any newly introduced friendly co-arrival or a conflict at the intended tree. Existing unmodified actor conflicts may persist. Observer alone reads submitted opponent actions. Real games stop at t100 or extinction; no full-game utility estimate. Fixtures use fresh history, each opponent reply fixed separately.

lattice.scope: Follow-up mechanism stress test after zero flips in the original bank-adjacent fixtures. All valid placements from cells at coordinates 1,4,7,10,13 in each axis, four neighbor directions, both seats, excluding base cells. New sparse cold-history fixtures at t80; one zero-cargo collector, one enemy planter on our age-9 tree. No retuning or selection of cells by outcome. First eight changed positions in traversal order have all five enemy replies replayed.
